art_direction: premium independent magazine spread with a clear point of view and calm editorial confidence
palette: paper ivory, carbon black, oxide red, muted marine blue
typography: high-contrast Chinese serif for conclusions paired with a restrained modern sans serif for support
materials: uncoated paper grain, hairline rules, print-like image treatment and quiet ink variation
text_layout: place text in a quiet paper field with intentional line breaks; a page may use a medium conclusion, a caption, or integrated labels rather than an oversized title
contrast: carbon-black or deep marine text on a quiet ivory or matte charcoal field; never place type over a face, high-frequency texture or bright highlight

magazine-cover.label: 杂志封面
magazine-cover.summary: 非对称裁切图片与明确主张组成有停留感的开场
magazine-cover.composition: asymmetric cover spread with one cropped documentary anchor and a quiet text field
magazine-cover.imagery: editorial photograph or abstract printed image crop; no extra cover lines or issue metadata
requirements: headline remains readable at projection distance

editorial-statement.label: 编辑判断
editorial-statement.summary: 让一条判断在纸面留白中停留，不依赖超大标题
editorial-statement.composition: low-density statement page with a medium-sized text block balanced by quiet paper or a small image field
editorial-statement.imagery: subtle paper texture, restrained crop or abstract ink gesture without added words
requirements: one sentence or short text cluster gets the most visual weight
use whitespace as an active element
avoid: quote attribution not present in exact_text

documentary-hero.label: 纪录主视觉
documentary-hero.summary: 用一幅有质感的主视觉承担大部分表达
documentary-hero.composition: full-height or dominant editorial image with a protected quiet text margin and controlled subject crop
documentary-hero.imagery: documentary photography with honest light, tactile detail and a single readable subject

title_treatment.weight: restrained sans caption or short serif claim

requirements: subject must not cross the text-safe zone
image carries the narrative without invented labels

profile-feature.label: 人物特写
profile-feature.summary: 人物、角色或局部细节与编辑式引文并置
profile-feature.composition: portrait or character detail on one side with an editorial quote field on the other
profile-feature.imagery: human-centered portrait, silhouette or user-provided character asset; identity details only when supplied

title_treatment.weight: quote-led serif with small supporting line

requirements: do not invent name, role or attribution
keep the face and text in separate quiet regions

editorial-diagram.label: 纸面图解
editorial-diagram.summary: 用墨线、有限色块和留白把关系讲清楚
editorial-diagram.composition: editorial diagram on a broad paper field with one dominant relationship and carefully spaced annotations
editorial-diagram.imagery: ink lines, paper cut shapes, small evidence marks and simple diagram geometry; labels only from exact_text

title_treatment.weight: short conclusion integrated with the diagram

requirements: relationship direction or grouping must be legible
all numbers and labels must be supplied

comparison-spread.label: 对照跨页
comparison-spread.summary: 两个阅读区域形成清楚的并置或对照
comparison-spread.composition: two balanced editorial reading zones separated by a thin rule or quiet gutter
comparison-spread.imagery: paired crops, paper blocks or concise diagrams with aligned baselines

title_treatment.weight: short comparison conclusion, not a banner

requirements: both columns use the same comparison dimension
avoid: comparison labels invented by the model

collage-scene.label: 编辑拼贴
collage-scene.summary: 以拼贴或编辑插画把抽象主张转成可感知的场景
collage-scene.composition: layered editorial collage with one dominant metaphor, irregular crop edges and generous quiet copy space
collage-scene.imagery: paper collage, cut photographic fragments or restrained editorial illustration without pseudo-labels
requirements: metaphor must support the supplied claim
no collage fragment may introduce readable extra text
